text: Your work is personal.
It deserves a private place.
Outcrop is that place.
Your record belongs to you.
Nothing goes in until you say so,
and nothing goes out until you choose to share it.
Start wherever feels natural.
Bring your résumé.
Outcrop lays out what it found,
and you decide what stays.
Then go deeper into any role on it.
Or simply begin with a story.
Outcrop listens, asks what a résumé never does,
and reflects back what you said, in your words.
When the story is clear, it becomes Evidence.
You check it, add when it happened
and the tools you used,
and only then is it saved.
Your Landscape shows what your Evidence supports.
No scores. No rankings.
Every capability traces back to your own words,
so you can stand behind all of it.
When a role catches your eye,
you’ll check it against your record:
what’s supported, what isn’t there yet,
and what you may have forgotten you did.
Your whole career, in one place,
ready when you need it.
Your work, in your words.
Kept private, kept yours.
Outcrop.
